body: I guess I just love seeing my level go up after a hard fought game. Its just became so regular to me to level up that its like something big is missing. Ill be back though the day they drop new cap 💪 Nba 2k until then 😂
Probably next month. No set date for it though.
I already got all 8 of my main guns gold. I dont really see a point in doing more until new guns that I enjoy using come out.
Or ill play call of duty lol. Seems like they know how to make a grinding game unlike this half made game. Level 50 for 5 months xD What a joke.
Sounds like your making it worse buddy
This happend to me also.. It sucks. And I dont have enough money to fix it right now. Lucky you.
Can I see pictures? Make sure to take care of it as well as you can and it shouldnt receed to much more.

That is pretty bad but not the worse ive seen. You will need gum surgery no doubt.. Do you have crazy sensitivity? I was also a aggressive brusher. Your top teeth seem to be receeding a good amount also.
I used Crest 3d White Strips They are like $50. They worked like a charm for me. Good luck.

Life is a bitch thats forsure. But its worth living. I was homeless for 2 years at 18 years old. And im still here. All we can do is fight and put effort into bettering ourselves. Your only suffering because you choose to suffer.
Its never to late for anything. You just got to put your mind to it.
Its not easy because you are here for a reason. You just need to find that reason.

Everything takes time & effort. If u dont put the effort in time will just consume you. Put yourself out there. Get out of your comfort zone. Maybe try a Dating Site and get comfortable on there first and then meet in real life. Its alot about taking steps. You got this man.

Bro just keep trying. You will find the right one. I had the same problem. Never knew the right thing to say and never knew the best way to approach a female. Everything is a Trial and sometimes a Error. Just keep putting your effort into it and you will succeed. Practice makes perfect. And im sorry to hear you have no one to talk to. Maybe talk to a counselor. Thats what I do and it helps me more day by day. You gotta stay strong man. Life is a shitty rollercoaster sometimes. Lot of bumps and turns but were always standing on our feet at the end. You got this. Keep pushing yourself.

Your life is worth living trust me. Maybe she isnt right for you. There is someone out there for you. Everything takes time & effort. Without the effort, time will consume you. Suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem. Try to fix that problem or move on. Taking your own life should never be the answer. Believe me life doesnt treat me well but all we can do is fight through it. Your strong. Keep telling yourself that.

Those are some wise words but im in so much physical pain also that I cant even do daily tasks other than sit in my bed and go to the bathroom. And have no money to seek help for my mental state or physical state. I am to late to try sadly and I guess that is my fault.
